UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents the user's primary profile, role, legal account type, subscription tier, and current wallet balance.

userId.description: Unique Firebase Auth UID of the user.

fullName.description: Full Arabic name of the user.

phone.description: Contact phone number with international country code.

accountType.description: Legal status: Individual (فرد) or Family Record Keeper (أمين السجل).

originCountry.description: Country of ancestral origin (e.g., SA, EG, YE).

subscriptionTier.description: Current subscription tier: Free, Basic ($5 verified root), or Premium Annual ($60/yr).

walletBalance.description: Available wallet credit balance in USD.

isRootUnlocked.description: Whether the $5 connection root is unlocked.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

ResearchTicket.title: ResearchTicket
ResearchTicket.description: Genealogical investigation ticket initiated when a lineage search yields no immediate automated match. Genealogists investigate historical sources and notify the customer upon resolution.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this search ticket.

targetAncestor.description: Target lineage chain supplied by customer (e.g. حسن زهير آل مقيت).

additionalNotes.description: Family oral history notes, known migrations, or elder testimonials.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of genealogical research.

assignedResearcherId.description: UID of the genealogical researcher assigned to the case.

researchFindings.description: Genealogist's findings, verified lineage chain, references to manuscripts and chronicles.

verifiedSources.description: Citations of historical documents, waqf registries, or Ottoman census records.

clientNotified.description: Whether an in-app and email notification has been dispatched to the client.

WalletTransaction.title: WalletTransaction
WalletTransaction.description: Financial ledger entry for user wallet balance changes (bonuses, top-ups, service purchases).

reason.description: Description of transaction (e.g. رصيد ترحيبي مع الاشتراك السنوي, شراء شهادة مشجرة مذهبة).

referenceId.description: Reference ID (e.g. subscription order ID or service request ID).

balanceAfter.description: User wallet balance after this transaction.

CustomerNotification.title: CustomerNotification
CustomerNotification.description: Proactive customer support message, feature announcement, or ticket status update sent to a user.

actionUrl.description: Optional in-app route or action identifier (e.g. /dashboard#vault).

actionLabel.description: Optional CTA button label (e.g. جرّب خزانتي الآن).

StaffMember.title: StaffMember
StaffMember.description: Internal Juthori team member record for genealogical researchers, support specialists, and platform managers.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of staff member.

role.description: Operational role: Platform Admin, Genealogist/Researcher, or Customer Care Agent.

specialization.description: Genealogical specialty (e.g. أنساب قبائل نجد والحجاز, وثائق بلاد الشام, سجلات مصر والمغرب العربي).

CrmCampaign.title: CrmCampaign
CrmCampaign.description: Periodic broadcast campaigns and proactive outreach sequences managed by customer service to engage users with new platform features.

messageTitle.description: Headline of the message sent to users.

bonusCreditsUsd.description: Optional promo wallet credit granted upon engagement.

/users/{userId}.description: Public and private user account profile, including subscription status, legal type, and wallet balance.

/users/{userId}/wallet_transactions/{txI.description: Subcollection recording all financial credit and debit transactions for the user's wallet.

/users/{userId}/notifications/{notifId}.description: Subcollection storing in-app customer service messages, research ticket updates, and feature notices for the user.

/research_tickets/{ticketId}.description: Central registry of genealogical research tickets opened when automated matches are absent, processed by Juthori researchers.

/staff/{staffId}.description: Registry of platform admins, genealogists, and customer care specialists for role-based access control.

/crm_campaigns/{campaignId}.description: Operational campaigns for proactive customer outreach and feature promotions.
